diagrams.title: System diagram
diagrams.change: Moved browser execution outside the server process and the Billing Stripe adapter inside it.

diagrams.title: End-to-end purchase
diagrams.change: Fixed parser-breaking semicolons; modeled browser return and webhook as independent paths; showed authorization.

diagrams.title: Provisioning and login workflow
diagrams.change: Separated one-time provisioning from login and added Identity-store failure.

diagrams.title: Guard and logout workflow
diagrams.change: Added fail-closed session-store failure and separated read, mutation and logout paths.

diagrams.title: Write workflow
diagrams.change: Made row-version enforcement atomic at commit and distinguished conflicts from dependency failures.

diagrams.title: Read and association workflow
diagrams.change: Added invalid-input and database-failure outcomes; retained stable-ID association.

diagrams.title: Create/edit/deactivate workflow
diagrams.change: Added commit-time version conflict; retained history and deactivation behavior.

diagrams.title: Trusted snapshot workflow
diagrams.change: Added rollback/lock-release path when snapshot commit fails.

diagrams.title: B1 — Capture and create Checkout
diagrams.change: Prevented resume from bypassing safe recovery; added first-attempt persistence and binding/concurrency outcomes.

diagrams.title: B2 — Ambiguous creation and recovery
diagrams.change: Added lease, never-attempted request, rejected request, safe-window, binding and persistence decisions.

diagrams.title: B3 — Hosted payment and browser return
diagrams.change: Removed misleading Pending resets; kept browser return independent of verified state.

diagrams.title: B4 — Webhook verification and atomic processing
diagrams.change: Added diagnostic commit failure, concurrent receipt recheck, session binding and duplicate-key rollback paths.

diagrams.title: B5 — Payment state machine
diagrams.change: Made Expired no-op behavior explicit while preserving authoritative-success precedence.

diagrams.title: B6 — Outage and acknowledgement recovery
diagrams.change: Added signature/evidence verification and provider response; removed ambiguous semicolons.

diagrams.title: Relationships
diagrams.change: Added account/environment components of event key and nullable relationship/reference annotations.
